notes: MetroCluster systems were previously indistinguishable from normal clusters anywhere in Technical Audit -- isMetroCluster is a real, reliably-populated field, but nothing surfaced it. Added an amber METROCLUSTER badge to the system header, multi-select dropdown, and selected-systems summary. Added a dedicated MetroCluster Configuration & DR Health card (MC node count, Mediator status, AUSO status, MC-specific findings) that always renders for MC systems -- previously this info only existed in the Action Planner's executive summary and only appeared when there were active findings, so a healthy MC pair showed nothing. Verified live against 8 real MetroCluster systems in the current fleet.
